_comment: Bubblewrap configuration for the Play Store build. The address is settled:
phaserugbymanager.com, bought 25 Aug and pointed at GitHub Pages, which is
also what public/CNAME tells Pages to answer to. ONE value is still a
placeholder - 'signingKey', the keystore that will sign every future update.
bubblewrap build creates it on first run; lose it and the listing can never
be updated again. See README.md in this folder.
appVersionCode goes UP by one on every upload, forever. Play rejects a
repeat, and a mismatched pair is the most common failed upload there is.
IT IS THE NUMBER THE NEXT UPLOAD WILL USE, NOT THE ONE PLAY IS ON.
Play's highest is 12 - the owner read it off Release > App bundle
explorer on 31 Aug (code 12 = 1.1.10, uploaded 29 Aug; codes 4 and 2
before it). That page is the only authority; this note guessed 4 from an
edge-to-edge warning that happened to name an old release, and was wrong.
IT IS 15, AND 15 IS WHAT PLAY ACTUALLY RECEIVED for v1.1.17 (31 Aug).
The 13 planned here never shipped: bubblewrap INCREMENTS THIS FIELD AND
WRITES IT BACK before every build, so the owner's machine went 11 -> 12
(rejected, Play held 12 already), was set to 14 by hand, and built 15.
That write-back is why this file is always a build behind reality unless
somebody records the number Play accepted - which is what this line is.
Skipped numbers are fine; Play only requires going UP.
appVersionName tracks the release the game calls itself (package.json,
and the build stamp on the title screen); appVersionCode counts UPLOADS,
not releases. If Play rejects a number as already taken, set one higher
and go again; the rule is only ever 'one higher than whatever Play has
seen'.
enableNotifications is true because Play Billing requires it - bubblewrap
refuses to build otherwise (caught on the owner's first real build, 26
Aug). It wires the Android notification channel the purchase flow needs
internally; the game itself never sends a push notification, and the
store listing's 'no data collected' claim is unaffected - see netprobe.
